Definition: Beeshterah, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Beeshterah means "with increase." It was a Levitical city in Manasseh, east of the Jordan; probably identical with 'Ashtaroth'. You will find it in Joshua 21:27.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Beeshterah is worth knowing, because God's people actually walked there.
